original_full_invoice.cpu: CPU_total is actual parent/driver and all compiler/control/helper child process CPU, including failed setup/cleanup and receipt tails, with each process lifetime counted once.
original_full_invoice.index: For every separately selected actual invocation j and every unique exclusive work segment e, assign exactly one C01-C15 owner. Assign shared setup to the actual common parent or to each actual fresh invocation as incurred; never omit or fabricate amortization.
original_full_invoice.peak: RSS_peak is actual aggregate concurrent high-water across parent/driver/children plus separately declared retained FD/image/page and allocator profile; a sum of individual maxima is not an observed aggregate peak.
original_full_invoice.setup_baseline: Both original complete arms pay the complete actual common control union, Root/native/source setup and teardown. Any asymmetry must be explicit and reviewed; no free candidate-only qualification or baseline control elision.
original_full_invoice.unmeasured: Every unevaluated time/CPU/byte value remains null/unknown. No unknown is treated as zero, no projected gain admitted and no price proof is inferred from symbolic completeness.
original_full_invoice.wall: W_total is actual outer admission-to-final-teardown elapsed time. Per-phase nested samples are diagnostic and must not be summed as if exclusive. Exclusive segment partition plus idle/wait/parent tails must reconcile to W_total.
